bio.text: Janice Marchman, a Democrat, has represented District 15 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2023 and previously served on the Thompson School District R-2J school board.
According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Marchman lives in Loveland, Colorado, and earned a bachelor's degree in industrial and systems engineering from the Georgia Institute of Technology in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as an engineer and as a teacher.
